---
name: Specification proposal
about: A change of behaviour, which is a change of the specification
labels: proposal
---

**Section.** The governing section the proposal amends.

**Statement.** The proposed text, as it would read in the specification.

**Ground.** Why: the defect it removes or the capability it adds, and how
it holds with the laws (MU-RECURSION) and the Concordance.

**Claims.** How the change will be proven.
